description: FighterEdge: prepare (unsigned) bring (name the fighter you bring as Muscle; you must own it), unbring, guard (station a fighter you own on a vehicle or apartment you own; needs guards ON, see get_fighter_edge) or unguard (the fighter then rests 24 hours). Costs nothing but gas.

assetKind.description: For guard and unguard: 1 vehicle or 2 apartment.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_fighter_edge
